thesis_at_purchase_vs_now: Consumer franchise: intact; integrated devices and services continue to create strong customer relationships [D01].
Pricing power: intact; ability to maintain premium positioning despite competition [D05].
Financial strength: strengthened; large net cash position and continued robust cash generation [D03], [D04].
final.price_vs_value_now: The stock trades at a trailing P/E of approximately 14.5x, which remains attractive for a business with these economics and competitive advantages [D04].
final.after_tax_hurdle: Not applicable as the decision is to add; the current valuation provides a sufficient margin of safety relative to our assessment of intrinsic value [D04].

drivers.driver: The business possesses a durable consumer franchise with high switching costs derived from an integrated ecosystem of hardware and services [D01].
Financial performance remains strong, with massive cash generation and a significant net cash balance providing substantial flexibility [D03], [D04].
The current valuation, at approximately 14.5x trailing earnings, is conservative for a business of this quality and offers a solid margin of safety [D04].
The position is currently a deputy-originated stake that warrants being built into a larger, Buffett-scale position over time [D07], [D08].

final.memo:
Charlie and I have watched the evolution of this business closely. It has become clear that the Company’s integrated ecosystem—linking hardware, software, and services—creates significant friction for users who might otherwise leave, forming a formidable moat [D01]. Despite the skeptics who worry about upgrade cycles or saturation, the Company has demonstrated an impressive ability to maintain premium pricing power and generate remarkable returns on capital [D01], [D05].

At a trailing price-to-earnings multiple of roughly 14.5x, we are not paying a premium price for this wonderful business [D04]. When you look at the cash generation capabilities and the enormous net cash position of over $150 billion, it is evident that the Company is well-positioned to navigate any cyclical headwinds [D03], [D04]. We do not need a catalyst; we simply want to own more of a business that is run by able managers and possesses such durable economic characteristics [D04].

While this began as a deputy’s position, the strength of the franchise justifies our commitment to building it into a significant holding for Berkshire [D07], [D08]. We will continue to add to our position over time, as we have done with other core franchises in the past, comfortable in the knowledge that we are buying a business that understands the importance of the long-term owner's perspective [D08].
